context: Custom hook tracks the browser window dimensions and returns { width, height }. Components use it to conditionally render mobile vs desktop layouts.
explanation: The cleanup return was removed — the resize event listener is never unsubscribed, so every call to useWindowSize leaks a listener. On unmount and re-mount cycles (e.g. navigating away and back) listeners stack up, firing stale setSize calls on unmounted components. Fix: restore the return () => window.removeEventListener("resize", handleResize) inside the effect.
